_about: Import settings for the Meshy excavator. Measured by Opus from the raw mesh (glTF frame, Y-up, machine faces -X in the source). Do not change without re-measuring.
_ground_note: ground = bottom of the tracks (the Meshy bucket hangs ~5 cm lower and sinks slightly into the ground)
_detail_note: 450k tris + 4096 texture chosen after visual review: 167k smeared the texture at UV seams.
